tonight.headline: Down 16.5 to 0 — Watson scored, then left with a concussion
body: Bad news first. Nothing has improved for Tuten or Likely overnight: Tuten's last practice report is Wednesday's DNP, Likely's a limited Wednesday, and Thursday's reports only arrive this afternoon. Diggs missed Wednesday for a personal reason. Footballers already have 16.5 from Christian Watson, who scored it before leaving at halftime with a concussion (PFF). You are 4-7.

Today: Caleb Williams for them at Detroit (12:00), then Allen for you against Emmett Johnson's Chiefs tonight (19:20). ESPN has it 130.0 to 134.2, 48%. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to move today. The Sunday 10:30 decisions on Tuten and Likely stand.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Tuten and Likely both sit, the fallbacks are not made, and Bowers and Smith-Njigba — both questionable for Footballers (Footballguys) — play. Chris Rodriguez Jr., Tuten's backup, sits on their bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising Thursday or Friday, or Likely upgraded to full; either moves Sunday back to 'start as set'. Bowers or Smith-Njigba ruled out narrows their 4.2-point projected edge.
